'''Jedi Heritage The Deck of Enlightenment''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jedi Heritage]]
* '''Published:''' 7 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor ECC Heritage LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

***Here is another one of my friend's deck....My rebel deck is mainly focused on countering the dtrategy of my Imperial

Deck.
